title: Mixed Event — My Color! — Episode5 The Unwanted Me

meta.Event Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's really wonderful that we got to see everyone's comments in real-time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But seeing everyone's comments right then and there really made it feel like our feelings reached them! It was really nice!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's different from what I imagined.>
<Is she going for a new image?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That's actually kind of interesting.>
<That's not the Shizuku I want to see.>
<She always seemed more refined, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If I consider the fans, the best thing would be to protect my Cheerful*Days image.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The fans are sure to be happy if I continue being the perfect Shizuku Hinomori they're familiar with.)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Wait... Isn't that Shizuku Hinomori over there?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is! She's so beautiful!
She really has that celebrity aura!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
It's amazing how she always dazzles like that?
Hey, should we try saying hi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Maybe if I try to smile and sign autographs like usual... But...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (No, I can't... I'll only end up disappointing them now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What should I do? If I try to get away, I'll just be recognized by someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The others would get upset if they knew I was using SEKAI this way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Is something wrong? You seem upset.
But you're still looking lovely regardless...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I'm not lovely or anything...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounds like something is wrong.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you feel comfortable talking about it, I'd be happy to listen.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku and Rin are busy practicing, so it's just me right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I understand. It's not easy to open up about yourself to someone you only met recently.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We should probably get to know each other a little better if we're going to be friends...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I have a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'll tell you a secret about myself, Shizuku.
Promise not to tell Miku or the others, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Indeed. Watch this.
I can stretch them out this much...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, they really are...! That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really are playful, aren't you, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're much lovelier when you smile, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you're willing to listen, would you mind if I told you about what happened?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. So that's what happened.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I really want MORE MORE JUMP! to inspire as many fans as possible, but I may end up limiting how we can reach them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I don't want to disappoint all my existing fans either...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That is a tough one. Nobody wants to disappoint their fans...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's been the same ever since I was little...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone has always done so much for me but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My carelessness always ends up disappointing someone without me realizing it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've lost track of how often I've been told, “It's such a waste for someone so beautiful...“

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No... It's the truth and I can't help it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also get told that I have a strong aura or a powerful presence about me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it was always so difficult for me to maintain that image.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even then, I thought that if I worked hard as an idol, I might be able to live up to their expectations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But in the end, nothing ever changed...
I never became what my fans expected me to be...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Being an idol really is tough. We're in a position where we have to be able to accept the feelings of so many, which is why we have to be mindful of each and every person.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So what do you plan on doing, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure the fans would be happier and more supportive if I kept being the idol they expect me to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Back then, I was happy knowing that I was living up to their expectations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I can't do that on my own...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't want to limit our options as a group just to protect my image...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But if I show the fans who I really am, I'm sure they'll be disappointed again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you sure that being your real self would be so bad?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Giving everyone hope for a better tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's the kind of group MORE MORE JUMP! strives to be, correct?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you saying the real Shizuku is unable to do that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, nobody wants to see the real me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm willing to bet there are plenty of people out there who would support you for who you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Support me for who I am...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Try taking a look around.
